# Start Throttle In Direction

Source: [4456](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4456); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Throttle In Direction](../../api/actions/start-throttle-in-direction.md).

<a id="wiki-4456-n1"></a>

- Starting throttle-in-direction cancels any previous instance; it can replace or add to existing input.

<a id="wiki-4456-n2"></a>

- Direction is normalized in selected world/local space; magnitude 1 is full input, with selected direction/magnitude reevaluation.
